name: Halfling
description: Halflings value life, home, and community, yet many possess a brave and adventurous spirit. Their legendary luck often seems to intervene at the moment they need it most.

grants.name: Brave
grants.description: You have Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

grants.name: Halfling Nimbleness
grants.description: You can move through the space of a creature larger than you, but you can't stop in that space.

grants.name: Luck
grants.description: When the d20 of a D20 Test rolls a 1, you can reroll it and must use the new result.

grants.name: Naturally Stealthy
grants.description: You can take the Hide action when you are obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.
